title: Numista.AI Golden Schema - 32 Columns
description: Canonical field definitions for all coin and currency items in Numista.AI. Ingestion pipelines, CSV importers, and AI grading tools should validate against this schema. Updated 2026-07-01.

id.description: Unique document identifier (Firestore doc_id or UUID). Auto-generated on ingest.

Year.description: Year of issue. May include suffix for special series (e.g. '1934-A' for currency).

Mint Mark.description: Mint mark letter (P, D, S, W, CC, O, etc.). Empty string if not applicable.

Denomination.description: Face value or denomination label (e.g. 'Quarter', '$1', 'Kennedy Half Dollar').

Quantity.description: Number of identical items in this record.

Program/Series.description: The official US Mint program or series name (e.g. 'American Women Quarters').

Theme/Subject.description: The theme or honoree depicted on the coin/note reverse.

Surface & Strike Quality.description: Strike/surface type. Canonical values: 'Business', 'Proof', 'Specimen', 'SMS', 'Burnished'. Maps from legacy 'Strike Type'.

Holder Type.description: Holder or encapsulation type (e.g. 'Raw', 'PCGS Slab', 'NGC Slab', 'OGP').

Certification Number.description: Grading certificate number issued by the grading service. Maps from legacy 'Grading Cert #'.

Melt Value.description: Estimated intrinsic melt value in USD. Populated by AI or market data enrichment.

Purchase Cost.description: Amount paid for this item in USD. Maps from legacy 'Cost'.

Purchase Date.description: Date of purchase (ISO 8601 format preferred: YYYY-MM-DD).

Retailer/Website.description: Name or URL of the retailer or auction site where purchased.

Retailer Invoice #.description: Invoice or order number from the retailer.

Retailer Item No..description: SKU or item number assigned by the retailer.

Variety.description: Die variety or mint error classification (e.g. 'Double Die Obverse', 'RPM').

Personal Notes I.description: Free-form personal notes from the collector. Maps from legacy 'Personal Notes'.

Personal Reference #.description: Collector-assigned reference number. Maps from legacy 'Personal Ref #'.

Storage Location.description: Physical storage location (e.g. 'Album 3, Page 5', 'Safe Deposit Box').

AI Estimated Value.description: AI-generated market value estimate in USD. Populated by Morgan AI valuation pipeline.

imageUrlObverse.description: GCS or CDN URL of the coin obverse (heads) image.

imageUrlReverse.description: GCS or CDN URL of the coin reverse (tails) image.

Original Description from source.description: Raw description text as originally provided in the source CSV or invoice.

series_description.description: Canonical AI-generated or reference library catalog history/essay. Strictly decoupled from Personal Notes I.

source_file.description: Source file or import batch identifier for traceability.

is_mint_set.description: True if item represents an intact mint/proof set asset.

set_broken_up.description: True if set has been split into standalone constituent coins.

parent_set_id.description: ID of parent mint set if this is a constituent coin.

constituent_coin_ids.description: Array of child coin IDs contained within this set.

canonical_set_sku.description: Canonical US Mint product SKU or catalog ID (e.g., 'USM-2026-UNC').
